title: In silico analysis based on network pharmacology and biomolecular informatics to explore the mechanism of action of Erjing Pills (from Shengji Zonglu) in the treatment of leukotrichia.
authors: Pu, Yun; Liu, Yang; Zhao, Qing; Kang, Qiao; He, Yunsheng; Zhao, Ping; Chen, Xinming; Liao, Fengwan; Yang, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究二精丸治疗白发的机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: This study aimed to explore the core active ingredients and potential molecular mechanisms of Erjing Pills, a prescription in the classic work of Traditional Chinese Medicine, "Shengji Zonglu," in the treatment of leukotrichia by utilizing network pharmacology and biomolecular docking techniques. The chemical components and potential targets of Chinese herbal medicines were analyzed through databases such as the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database. The targets related to leukotrichia were collected using GeneCards. The intersection targets were obtained using RStudio. The protein-protein interaction (PPI) network map and the "drug-component-target-disease" visualization network were generated using Cytoscape and STRING to screen the core components and key targets. Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment analyses were carried out using the Database for Annotation, Visualization and Integrated Discovery and RStudio. Finally, molecular docking verification was performed by AutoDock and PyMOL (Schrodinger LLC). The key active ingredients of Erjing Pills in the treatment of leukotrichia are beta-sitosterol, quercetin, baicalein, and stigmasterol. The top 5 PPI core target proteins, in order, are AKT serine/threonine kinase 1, interleukin 6, tumor protein p53, cysteine-aspartic acid protease 3, and interleukin 1 beta. The Gene Ontology enrichment analysis suggests that the biological processes mainly include responses to exogenous stimuli, membrane rafts, and DNA-binding transcription factor binding. The Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathways involve signal pathways such as lipid and atherosclerosis, hepatitis B, Kaposi sarcoma virus infection, chemical carcinogenesis, and human cytomegalovirus infection. The molecular docking results indicate that most of the main active ingredients in Erjing Pills have relatively stable binding activities with the key targets, such as AKT serine/threonine kinase 1, interleukin 6, tumor protein p53, cysteine-aspartic acid protease 3, and interleukin 1 beta, in the PPI network. The active ingredients of Erjing Pills may interfere with the pathological process of leukotrichia by regulating key targets and signal pathways. This study provides a theoretical basis for the clinical application of Erjing Pills and indicates the direction for subsequent experimental research.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在利用网络药理学和生物大分子对接技术，探讨经典中医著作《圣济总录》中的处方二精丸治疗白发的核心活性成分及潜在分子机制。通过中药系统药理学数据库等数据库分析中药的化学成分和潜在靶点。利用GeneCards收集与白发相关的靶点。使用RStudio获取交集靶点。通过Cytoscape和STRING生成蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络图和“药物-成分-靶点-疾病”可视化网络，以筛选核心成分和关键靶点。利用注释、可视化和综合发现数据库及RStudio进行基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书富集分析。最后，通过AutoDock和PyMOL（Schrodinger LLC）进行分子对接验证。二精丸治疗白发的关键活性成分为β-谷甾醇、槲皮素、黄芩素和豆甾醇。PPI核心靶点蛋白前5位依次为AKT丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶1、白细胞介素6、肿瘤蛋白p53、半胱氨酸-天冬氨酸蛋白酶3和白细胞介素1β。基因本体论富集分析表明，生物过程主要包括对外源刺激的反应、膜筏和DNA结合转录因子结合。京都基因与基因组百科全书通路涉及脂质与动脉粥样硬化、乙型肝炎、卡波西肉瘤病毒感染、化学致癌和人类巨细胞病毒感染等信号通路。分子对接结果表明，二精丸中大多数主要活性成分与PPI网络中的关键靶点（如AKT丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶1、白细胞介素6、肿瘤蛋白p53、半胱氨酸-天冬氨酸蛋白酶3和白细胞介素1β）具有相对稳定的结合活性。二精丸的活性成分可能通过调节关键靶点和信号通路干扰白发的病理过程。本研究为二精丸的临床应用提供了理论依据，并为后续实验研究指明了方向。
